question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between C and U when counted from the left of U. B sits third to the left of A. T sits to the immediate right of A.T sits second to the left of C. R is not an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits third to the right of S?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between C and U when counted from the left of U.

B sits third to the left of A.

T sits to the immediate right of A.

T sits second to the left of C.

R is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0f494569baa101d1c7481f035521421b33d00e631d7c30c518472a69bcb90f8.png] 

Here,T sits third to the right of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
